'''FD-series extinguisher droids''' were a line of [[Firefighter droid/Legends|firefighter droid]] produced by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. Available for 8000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the droids were designed for the sole purpose of putting out fires, carrying a large tank of flame retardant chemicals to allow them to complete that task. Normally mounted on tracked chassis or using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], they were particularly useful aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], where fire would quickly burn up valuable [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Able to respond quickly and operate in conditions an organic being never could, the droids were used on vessels from the size of a light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] up to that of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and larger. The number of FD-series droids needed to adequately protect a ship depended on its size with only one for the smallest vessels they were used on, but hundreds for [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The FD-series extinguisher droid was first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
